senses.gloss:
श्रु 1. श्रु (regarded by native gram-
marians as an irregular rt. of cl. 1), cl. 5. P.
शृणोति (ep. also A. शृणुते, 1st du. P. शृणुवस्
or शृण्वस्), Impv. श्रिणोतु (2nd sing. शृणु Ved.,
शृणुहि, शृणुधी, Pāṇ. VI. 4, 102, and श्रुधि,
as if cl. 2), शुश्राव (2nd sing. शुश्रोथ, 1st du.
शुश्रुव, 1st pl. शुश्रुम), अश्रौषीत्, (Ved. forms
श्रोषन् = शृण्वन्ति, श्रोषन्तु = शृण्वन्तु,
शृण्विषे, शृणोतु, शृणवत्, श्रवत्, शुश्रवत्),
श्रोतुम्, to hear, listen to (with acc.), give ear
to (with acc. or gen.); to be attentive, be obedient,
obey; to go (according to Vopa-deva): Pass. श्रू-
यते (शृण्वे = श्रूयते, Ṛg-veda I. 74, 7; शृण्-
विरे = श्रूयन्ते, Ṛg-veda I. 15, 8), Aor. अश्रावि, to
be heard; to be celebrated or renowned (Ved.);
to be called (Ved.): Caus. श्रावयति, -ते, -यितुम्,
Aor. अशिश्रवत्, -त, or अशुश्रवत्, -त, to cause
any one to hear anything (with two acc.), tell, nar-
rate, relate: Pass. of Caus. श्राव्यते: Desid. of
Caus. शिश्रावयिषति, -ते, or (according to some)
शुश्रावयिषति, -ते: Desid. शुश्रूषते, to desire to
hear or listen to; to attend to, obey, be obedient to
[]
(with acc.); to wait upon, tend, serve: Intens.
शोश्रूयते, शोश्रवीति, शोश्रोति; [cf. Gr. κλύ-ω,
κλῦ-θι (= श्रुधि), κλυ-τό-ς (= श्रुत), κλέ-ος,
κλε-ί-ω, κλέ-ο-μαι, κλε-ιν-ό-ς, κλει-τό-ς,
ἀ-κρο-ά-ομαι, (perhaps also) κλαίω, κλαύσω, καλέω for
κλαϝέω: Lat. clu-o, clu-e-o, cli-ens, in-clu-tu-s,
clamo, (probably also) aus-cul-to, laudo for
claus-do: Goth. hliu-ma, hrotheigs, (perhaps)
hausja for hlausja: Old Germ. hlū-t (= श्रुत
= Mod. Germ. Laut); hlūti, ‘a sound;’ hlūtian,
‘to sound;’ hliu-munt (= Mod. Germ. Leumund),
hlio-tar; hlo-s-en, hloson, hlosian, losen, ‘to
hear;’ hōrin; hlamon: Old Sax. hlus-t; hlāmon,
‘to sound:’ Angl. Sax. hlud, hlyd, hlowan, hlyn,
hlyrian (?), hliosa, hlyst, hlystan: Eng. listen:
Slav. slu-ti, slov-o, ‘a word;’ slava, ‘fame:’ Lith.
szlove, ‘honour;’ klau-s-au, ‘I hear;’ slowiju, ‘I
praise, celebrate;’ perhaps klabu, ‘to speak:’ Russ.
slusaju, ‘I listen;’ slav-i-tj, ‘to celebrate;’ slovo,
‘a word, speech:’ Hib. cluinim, ‘I hear;’ cluas,
‘ear;’ clos, ‘hearing, report;’ cloisim, cluisim,
‘I hear.’]

श्रु 2. श्रु (a less correct reading for rt.
स्रु, q. v.), cl. 1. P. श्रवति, &c., to flow,
go, &c.

श्रू श्रू, ऊस्, according to Vopa-deva XXVI.
75. connected with a rt. श्रिव् for स्रिव्.

स्रु स्रु (incorrectly written श्रु, see rt.
2. श्रु), cl. 1. P. स्रवति (ep. rarely A. -ते),
सुस्राव (1st du. सुस्रुव), स्रोष्यति, असुस्रुवत्,
स्रोतुम् (Ved. Inf. स्रवितवे, स्रवितवै), to flow,
stream, trickle, ooze, drip, drop, distil, exude; to
move, go; to let flow, shed (with acc.); to trickle
away, slip away, waste away, perish; to flow from
(with abl.); to be diffused or spread about, trans-
pire: Caus. स्रावयति, -यितुम्, Aor. असुस्रवत् or
असिस्रवत्, to cause to flow, pour out, shed, effuse,
spill: Desid. of Caus. सुस्रावयिषति or सिस्राव-
यिषति: Desid. सुस्रूषति: Intens. सोस्रूयते,
सोस्रोति; [cf. Gr. ῥέ-ω (for σρεϝω), ῥεύ-σω, ἐ-ῤῤύη-ν,
ῥέ-ος, ῥό-ο-ς, ῥεῦ-μα, ῥο-ή, ῥύ-σι-ς, ῥεῦ-σι-ς, ῥυ-τό-ς,
ῥευσ-τό-ς, ῥέ-ε-θρο-ν, ῥύ-αξ, ῥύ-μη,
[]
ῥυ-θ-μό-ς, Στρύμων: Lat. riv-u-s, Rumo, rumen, Ru-
mina: Old Germ. strou-m, sliu-mo, ‘quickly;’
sliumor, ‘quicker:’ Mod. Germ. schleunig: Lith.
srav-j-u, ‘to flow;’ srov-e: Slav. s-t-ru-ja, o-s-t-
rovu, ‘an island:’ Hib. sruth, ‘stream.’]

स्रू, ऊस्, f. a sacrificial ladle (= स्रुव above);
a spring, fountain, cascade.

श्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, heard, listened to; reported,
heard of; ascertained, understood; called; (अस्), m.,
N. of an enemy of Indra (Ved.); of a son of Dharma;
of a son of Bhagīratha; of a son of Upagu; of a
son of Kṛṣṇa; (अम्), n. the object of hearing;
that which was heard from the beginning, the Veda,
revelation, sacred knowledge, holy writ, &c.
—श्रुत-
ऋषि, इस्, इस्, इ, Ved. one by whom the Ṛṣis have
been heard, (Sāy. = श्रुता ऋषयो येन; cf. श्रु-
[]
तर्षि.)
—श्रुत-कक्ष, अस्, m., N. of a Vedic
Ṛṣi (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda VIII. 81).
—श्रुत-कर्मन्, आ, m., N. of a son of Saha-deva.
—श्रुत-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f. ‘Veda-renown,’ fame of divine
science; (इस्, इस्, इ), having renowned fame, cele-
brated, famous; (इस्), m. epithet of various persons;
a divine sage; a generous man, benefactor, donor;
(इस्), f. a river; N. of the wife of Śatru-ghna; of
other women.
—श्रुत-केवलिन्, इनस्, m. pl. epithet
of a class of Jaina Arhats (of whom six are enume-
rated).
—श्रुतञ्-जय, अस्, m., N. of a king.
—श्रु-
त-देवा, f., N. of a daughter of Śūra and wife of
Vṛddha-śarman.
—श्रुत-देवी, f. ‘goddess of learn-
ing,’ epithet of Sarasvatī.
—श्रुत-धर, अस्, आ,
अम्, recollecting or remembering what has been
heard, having or observing the Vedas; (अस्), m., N.
of a poet; (आस्), m. pl., N. of a people (inhabiting
a division of Plaksha-dvīpa).
—श्रुत-प्रकास, अस्,
आ, अम्, renowned for knowledge of the Vedas.
—श्रुत-बन्धु, उस्, m., N. of the author of
several hymns in the Ṛg-veda.
—श्रुत-बोध, अस्,
m., N. of a treatise on the most common Sanskrit
metres by a certain Kālidāsa.
—श्रुतर्षि (˚त-
ऋषि), इस्, m. a kind of secondary Ṛṣi, one by
whom the Vedic Ṛṣis have been heard; the son of
a Ṛṣi; a Ṛṣi of a particular order (as the author
of the Su-śruta).
—१. श्रुत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्, one
who has heard, hearing.
—२. श्रुत-वत्, आन्, अती, अत्,
possessing or knowing the Veda, instructed in sacred
learning, pious; (आन्), m., N. of a king.
—श्रुत-
विद्, त्, m. ‘knowing sacred revelation,’ N. of an
Ātreya (author of the hymn Ṛg-veda V. 62).
—श्रुत-शील, अस्, m. a proper N.
—श्रुत-श्रवस्,
आस्, m., N. of a king; (आस्), f., N. of a daughter of
Śūra.
—श्रुतश्रवो-ऽनुज (˚वस्-अन्˚), अस्, m. ‘born
after Śruta-śravas,’ the planet Saturn (said to be one
of the sons of Sūrya).
—श्रुत-श्रोणी, f. a kind of
plant (= द्रवन्ती).
—श्रुत-सेन, अस्, m., N. of a
son of Parīkṣit.
—श्रुत-सोम, अस्, m., N. of a
son of Bhīma.
—श्रुतादान (˚त-आद्˚), अम्, n.
‘Veda-acceptation,’ citing the Vedas.
—श्रुताध्य-
यन-सम्पन्न (˚त-अध्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, well read
in sacred science, conversant with the Vedas.
—श्रु-
तान्वित (˚त-अन्˚), अस्, आ, अम्, acquainted with or
conforming to the Vedas.
—श्रुता-मघ, अस्, आ,
अम्, Ved. having renowned treasures.
—श्रुतायु or
श्रुतायुस् (˚त-आय्˚), उस्, m., N. of a king of the
solar race descended from Kuśa, son of Rāma; of a
son of Purū-ravas; of another king:
—श्रुतार्थ
(˚त-अर्˚), अस्, m. ‘heard-matter,’ any matter ascer-
tained by hearing, a fact verbally or orally communi-
cated.

स्रूत, अस्, आ, अम्, gone; dried, become dry,
(Pāṇ. VI. 4, 20.)

स्रुत, अस्, आ, अम्, flowed, trickled, flowing, drop-
ping, dripping, fluid; (आ), f. a kind of medicinal
plant (= हिङ्गु-पत्त्री).

श्रुतर्य, अस्, m., Ved., N. of a man (protected
by the Aśvins).
श्रुतर्वन्, आ, m. a proper N.

श्रुति, इस्, f. ‘audition,’ hearing; an ear; anything
heard, sound, oral account, report, rumour, intelli-
gence, news; that which was heard or revealed from
the beginning, revelation, the Veda (i. e. sound
eternally heard and so differing from स्मृति or what
is only remembered and handed down by human
authors, see Manu II. 10; properly applied to works
considered to have been revealed by a deity, and
therefore only to the Mantra and Brāhmaṇa portion
of the Vedas, but often applied also to the Upaniṣads
and other Vedic works); any Vedic or sacred text,
(इति श्रुतेः, according to or because of such a श्रुति
or Vedic text); the hearing of a sound, a sound;
the diagonal of a tetragon or hypothenuse of a
triangle; (in music) a particular division of the
octave, a quarter tone or interval, (twenty-two of
these are enumerated, four constituting a major tone,
three a minor, and two a semitone; they are said
to be personified as nymphs); the constellation Śra-
vaṇā.
—श्रुति-कट, अस्, m. penance, expiation; a
snake; (according to Śabda-k.) = प्राञ्चल्लोह.
—श्रुति-कटु, उस्, उस्, उ, harsh to the ear, unme-
lodious; (उस्), m. a harsh or unmelodious sound,
cacophony (a fault in rhetoric).
—श्रुति-कथित, अस्,
आ, अम्, mentioned in the Veda, taught or prescribed
by the Vedas.
—श्रुति-कीर्त्ति, इस्, f., N. of a work.
[]
—श्रुति-चोदन, अम्, n. ‘Veda-precept,’ holy pre-
cept or injunction, the doctrine of the Vedas.
—श्रुति-
जीविका, f. a law-book or code of laws.
—श्रुति-तत्-
पर, अस्, आ, अम्, intent on hearing; intent on
studying the Veda.
—श्रुति-द्वैध, अम्, n. dis-
agreement or contradiction of any two passages in
the Vedas or of two Vedas.
—श्रुति-धर, अस्, आ,
अम्, ascertaining or perceiving by the ear, hearing;
holding or observing the Vedas; (अस्), m., N. of a
poet; [cf. श्रुत-धर.]
—श्रुति-निदर्शन, अम्,
n. the evidence of revelation, testimony of the Veda.
—श्रुति-प्रसादन, अस्, ई, अम्, gratifying the ear,
grateful to the ear.
—श्रुति-प्रामाण्यतस्, ind. on
the authority of the Veda, with the sanction of the
Veda.
—श्रुति-मण्डल, अम्, n. ‘ear-circle,’ the
outer ear.
—श्रुति-मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, possessed of ears,
capable of hearing.
—श्रुति-मूल, अम्, n. the root of
the ear; the text of the Vedas.
—श्रुति-मूलक, अस्,
आ, अम्, founded on the Veda, springing from the
Veda.
—श्रुति-मृग्य, अस्, आ, अम्, to be sought by
hearing or by the Vedas (not by sight).
—श्रुति-वर्-
जित, अस्, आ, अम्, devoid of hearing, deaf; ignorant
or unread in the Vedas.
—श्रुति-विप्रतिपन्न, अस्,
आ, अम्, dissenting from revelation, disregarding the
doctrine of the Veda.
—श्रुति-विषय, अस्, m. the
object of hearing (i. e. sound, see विषय); subject-
matter or doctrine of the Veda, any sacred matter or
ordinance; (अस्, आ, अम्), conversant with sacred
matters, familiar with the Veda.
—श्रुति-विषय-
गुण, अस्, आ, अम्, ‘having the quality [sound] which
is the object of hearing or which is perceptible by
the ear,’ epithet of ether.
—श्रुति-वेध, अस्, m. the
piercing or boring of the ear.
—श्रुति-स्फोटा, f. a
kind of creeper (= कर्ण-स्फोटा).
—श्रुति-स्मृति,
ई, f. du. the Veda and legal tradition, the Veda
and institutes of law.
—श्रुति-स्मृति-विरुद्ध,
अस्, आ, अम्, opposed to the Vedas and to tra-
dition or law.
—श्रुति-स्मृति-विहित, अस्, आ, अम्,
enjoined by the Vedas and the law.
—श्रुति-स्मृत्य्-
उदित, अस्, आ, अम्, declared or enjoined by the Veda
and law.
—श्रुत्य्-अनुप्रास, अस्, m. repetition of
sound, alliteration.
—श्रुत्य्-उक्त or श्रुत्य्-उदित,
अस्, आ, अम्, said or enjoined by the Vedas.
श्रुती, f. = श्रुति.

स्रुति, इस्, f. flow, flowing, streaming, oozing,
distilling; exudation, resin; a stream; (Ved.) a
path, by-way, course, road, (Sāy. = मार्ग; in Ṛg-
veda X. 88, 15. द्वे स्रुती अशृणवम् पित्रीणां
देवानाम् उत is translated, ‘I have heard of two
paths, that of the fathers and that of the gods.’)

श्रुतिन्, ई, इनी, इ, hearing; obeying, observing;
having or possessing the Veda, following the Veda.

श्रुत्-कर्ण, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. one who has hearing
ears, quick-hearing.

श्रुत्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. to be heard, famous,
glorious.
श्रुत्वा, ind. having heard or listened to, &c.
स्रूत्वा, ind. = स्रेवित्वा below.

श्रुश्रुतवत्, आन्, अती, अत् (doubtful; said to be a
reduplicated form), one who has heard.

श्रुष्ट, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. (according to some)
heard, handed down, (श्रुष्टे, according to tradition
or ordinance.)
श्रुष्ट, श्रुष्टि, श्रुष्टी, &c. See col. 1.

श्रुष्टि, इस्, f., Ved. hearing, listening to, audience;
help, assistance; a boon; prosperity, happiness,
abundance, (Sāy. = यज्ञ-फल-रूपं सुखम्,
Ṛg-veda I. 69, 4.)
—श्रुष्टि-गु, उस्, m., N. of the
author of one of the Vālakhilya hymns.
—श्रुष्टि-
मत्, आन्, अती, अत्, Ved. possessing happiness, pros-
perous, happy, (Sāy. = सुख-वत्.)

श्रुष्टी, ind. (according to some an old inst. or
dat. for श्रुष्ट्यै), Ved. having heard, having
listened to, (Sāy. = श्रुत्वा, Ṛg-veda VIII. 23, 14);
‘as soon as heard,’ readily, quickly, in a moment,
(Sāy. = क्षिप्रम्; in Ṛg-veda II. 3, 9. श्रुष्टी is
regarded as a nom. c. masc. and explained by क्षि-
प्र-गुणः.)

श्रुष्टी-वन्, आ, अरी, अ, Ved. possessing happiness,
granting prosperity, (Sāy. on Ṛg-veda I. 45, 2. ex-
plains श्रुष्टीवानः by श्रुष्टिः फलस्य दानं
तद्-भाजः; in Ṛg-veda I. 119, 1. श्रुष्टीवानम्
= क्षिप्रं सम्भजमानम् or सुखवन्तम्;
श्रुष्टीवरीः = सुखवत्यः, Ṛg-veda X. 30, 11);
listening to, helping (according to some).

श्रूयमाण, अस्, आ, अम्, being heard, heard.
—श्रूयमाण-त्व, अम्, n. the state or condition
of being heard.

श्रुव, अस्, m. (for स्रुव, q. v.), a sacrificial ladle,
(according to some अम्, n.); a sacrifice, oblation;
(आ), f. a kind of creeper or shrub (= मूर्वा).
—श्रुवा-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the Vikaṅkata tree.

स्रुव, अस्, आ, m. f. [cf. स्रुच्], a wooden ladle
(of a semicircular shape with a double extremity, or
two oval collateral excavations, used to pour ghee on
the sacrificial fire, = 2. जुहू); a Soma ladle, Soma
spoon; (आ), f. the Mūrvā plant; the tree Boswellia
Thurifera.
—स्रुव-हस्त, अस्, m. epithet of Śiva.
—स्रुवा-वृक्ष, अस्, m. the plant or tree Fla-
courtia Sapida.

श्रुग्वारु श्रुग्वारु, उस्, m. the plant Fla-
courtia Sapida (= विकङ्कत).

श्रुघ्निका श्रुघ्निका, f. impure carbonate of
soda, natron, alkali.

श्रुष् श्रुष्, a form in Ved. assumed by rt.
1. श्रु (q. v.) in certain tenses and derivatives.

स्रुत्, त्, त्, त्, flowing, &c. (at the end of comps.,
see परि-स्रुत्, अमृत-स्रुत्, &c.).
स्रुघ्न स्रुघ्न, अस्, m., N. of a country.
स्रुघ्नी, f. natron, (see स्रुग्-घ्नी under स्रुच्.)

स्रुच् स्रुच्, क्, f. (connected with rt. स्रु and
by some derived fr. स्रु + अञ्च्, cf. स्रुव, स्रू), a
sort of wooden ladle used for pouring clarified butter
on a sacrificial fire, (it ought to be made of Palāśa
or Khadira wood.)
—स्रुक्-प्रणालिका, f. the spout
of a ladle.
—स्रुग्-घ्नी, f. (probably fr. स्रुच् +
घ्नी; but also spelt स्रुघ्नी), natron, alkali.
—स्रुग्-
दारु, उस्, m. the tree Flacourtia Sapida.
—स्रुग्-वत्,
आन्, अती, अत्, having a ladle.

स्रुचय, Nom. P. स्रुचयति = स्रुग्वन्तम्
आचष्टे or करोति, (see Vopa-deva XXI. 14.)

स्रुच्य, अस्, आ, अम्, Ved. being in a sacrificial
ladle, contained in a ladle.
स्रुप स्रुप. See स्तुप.
